card.summary: No storage quota at all in self-hosted Mattermost, free or paid. Only the per-file ceiling is configurable: default 100 MB (`MaxFileSize = 104857600` bytes),...

free_tier.stated: No storage quota at all in self-hosted Mattermost, free or paid. Only the per-file ceiling is configurable: default 100 MB (`MaxFileSize = 104857600` bytes), settable to anything.

per_object_cap.stated: per-file ceiling is configurable: default 100 MB

egress.terms: Your server. Free of platform metering; you pay the host.

record.tooling: Mattermost REST API v4 `POST /api/v4/files` (multipart, up to 10 files per post) returning file IDs. Team Edition is MIT-licensed; Entry is the free mode of Enterprise Edition.
record.chaining: N self-hosted deployments; 10,000 teams per deployment; users per team 'no enforced limit'. Storage is whatever disk you mount. Including an S3/MinIO backend via FileSettings.

limits.value: per-file ceiling is configurable: default 100 MB

record.limits_note: 100 MB per attachment default (configurable), 10 attachments per post, 16,383-char messages. Entry caps message history at 10,000 channel messages across all channels and 1,000 Board cards.
record.reliability_note: Zero platform risk. Nothing can delete your files. The failure mode is operational: attachments live on the app server's local disk unless you configure S3, and the docs warn that raising MaxFileSize risks server crashes on large uploads.

evidence.proved: 'Attachment file size | 100 MB | Configurable'; 'Attachments per message ... 10'; 'Teams per deployment 10,000'; 'Users per team No enforced limit'
'The maximum file size for message attachments and plugin uploads... The default is 104857600 bytes (100 mebibytes)'
'Team Edition is a free-to-use, open source, self-hosted collaboration platform... MIT'

record.notes: No storage quota at all in self-hosted Mattermost, free or paid. Only the per-file ceiling is configurable: default 100 MB (`MaxFileSize = 104857600` bytes), settable to anything.

dead_end.why: No storage quota at all in self-hosted Mattermost, free or paid. Only the per-file ceiling is configurable: default 100 MB (`MaxFileSize = 104857600` bytes), settable to anything.
